build_mobilenetv2_backbone: build a MobileNetV2 backbone model with default widen factor and output indices
create_invertedresidual_block: create an InvertedResidual block with specified input output channels and expansion ratio
build_mobilenetv2_with_widening: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with a custom widen factor to scale channel widths
freeze_mobilenetv2_stages: freeze specific stages of the MobileNetV2 backbone to prevent gradient updates
enable_checkpointing_mobilenetv2: build a MobileNetV2 backbone with gradient checkpointing enabled to save memory during training
